STF watch is a newly designed and developed application which is only work for our new line of smart watches.
Main features:
Sync your steps,calories,mileage,heart rate,sleep and your exercise records recorded by your watch. The newly designed UI can display the data more intuitively.
After you bind and authorize,we will push your phone’s incoming call and SMS to your watch to avoid you missing information.
You can use the app to configure your watch’s sedentary alert,alarm clocks,schedules,backlight as well as sync weather and AGPS files(assisting the watch itself to locate) and other features, so you can use your watch better.
In the course of your use, if you have any questions, you can always ask, we will listen to your suggestions and make improvements.
